brief:
Bellingcat found that the European Union's freely available Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1 satellite imagery is experiencing a 24-hour delay over Gaza and parts of the West Bank. The analysis identified the postponement affecting the EU Space Program's publicly accessible satellite data for the contested territories.

The reason for the delay was not specified in Bellingcat's findings. Sentinel satellites typically provide near-real-time Earth observation data to researchers, journalists, and the public for monitoring conflict zones and documenting changes on the ground.

title: EU satellite imagery delayed over Gaza and West Bank
